attributes.board_name: Nevada State Board of Veterinary Medical Examiners

rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses provided or approved by AVMA and its specialty groups, Western/Wild West or other regional veterinary conferences, state and US Departments of Agriculture, AAHA, AAVSB RACE, Nevada VMA, Nevada System of Higher Education, AVMA-accredited vet schools, AVMA-CVTEA vet-tech programs, other states' vet boards, statewide/regional vet or vet-tech associations
rules.new_licensee_rule: Licensed on or after July 1 of the preceding even-numbered year: 20 hours in the preceding 12 months (max 10 by distance learning).
rules.audit_note: Random audits; proof due within 30 days of notice. Keep documentation 4 years.
rules.notes: Biennial: 40 hours in the 24 months before the new licensing period, max 20 by distance learning/correspondence (R026-26 doubled the former 20 h/12-month rule). Renewal application due May 15 of odd-numbered years; license forfeited if not renewed by Aug 31.
